steps.text:
Fixed utility ordering so general spacing utilities are emitted before axis and side-specific ones.

`p-4 pl-0` now correctly leaves left padding at `0`. The same precedence fix applies to positive and negative margin utilities.

Updated the generated CSS fixture and added a regression test. `npm test` passes.
